label: amoxicillin 500 mg oral capsule (Amoxil), fasted, n=8, serum
note: Arancibia A, Guttmann J, Gonzalez G, Gonzalez C. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 1980;17(2):199-202, p.201 Table 3 (PMC283758, scanned page; the erratum in 18(3):491 changes no value). Healthy fasted adults (7 M, 2 F; mean 66.4 kg of the 9 enrolled). Microbiological assay, sensitivity 0.25 ug/mL. The 20 min, 30 min and 7 h means (0.3, 1.6, 0.7 ug/mL) cover only the subjects with detectable drug (3, 6 and 4 of the 8), not the group, so they are left out here.
